goals.description: Unconditionally bind MemoryCortex in src/swarm/engine.ts with in-memory persistence and includeShared cross-app retrieval
goals.verificationCriteria: Engine initializes MemoryCortex even when QDRANT_URL is omitted; workflow uses in-memory vector fallback to retrieve baselines and distill exemplars; supports params.cortex injection and settings.includeShared
goals.evidence: Bound MemoryCortex unconditionally in src/swarm/engine.ts using defaultCortexRegistry per appId and shared fallbackStore in MemoryCortex; supported params.cortex injection, settings.includeShared, and fast-path exemplar persistence; verified via Step 18 in test-portable-swarm.ts; tsc and npm test passed with 0 errors.

goals.description: Implement cross-provider Critic routing and fast-path learning capture in src/swarm/engine.ts
goals.verificationCriteria: Dedicated critic/verifier agent or alternative provider is selected as critic; fast-path executions store baseline exemplars into MemoryCortex

goals.description: Add automated memory consolidation triggers and configurable dense/sparse RRF weights in MemoryCortex
goals.verificationCriteria: Automatic pruning of low-rated memories (<0.40) triggers after threshold store count; RRF accepts denseWeight and sparseWeight factors

goals.description: End-to-End multi-session learning verification, typecheck, build, and automated test suite pass
goals.verificationCriteria: Automated tests verify that sequential workflow executions without Qdrant accumulate positive exemplars, retrieve baselines, and improve responses; tsc and npm test pass
